lens: FEASIBILITY & EFFICIENCY critic. Questions checked: is the base choice sound, is the phase order the fastest route to something visible, are the estimates realistic for Claude Code plus one supervising non-artist user, is any legal point hand-waved, and is every claim backed by the dossier. I spot-checked the local RA2 VM clone at /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-lukegogogo-claude-code-projects---2----/db472532-d13c-48f5-a638-abe179791f90/scratchpad/repos/ra2-games__ra2 (HEAD f25986b) for the hash-gating claims.
factual_problems: The plan says 游戏逻辑一行不改 / 原版游戏逻辑一行不改 several times. The dossier's adversarial technical verdict refuted 'unmodified exe'. RA2 VM already patches guest code at runtime: the Short Game defeat check at 0x4E4A9C, repairRa2InvalidRepairRate, the startup and battle trampolines, and a binkw32 instruction patch. For YR it skips the startup movie at 0x52C5E0 (verified in src/games/yr/runtimeHooks.ts). The L2 draw-skip hooks would add more patches. Correct wording: 'original logic plus a small set of signature-checked runtime patches'.

The G1 framing is wrong (VERIFIED in the clone). The plan says 'RA2 VM 的所有补丁都锁定了特定的 exe 哈希… 如果不一致，要么重新逆向推导所有补丁地址（至少几周）'. For YR, the only hash-throwing code is in optional paths: the direct `?start-page=` skirmish/battle/lan trampolines (shared/startupTrampoline.ts:29, shared/battleStartup.ts:28), spawnerProbe.ts:45 (dev only), the perf frame reader, and networkTiming.ts:33, which returns false on mismatch rather than failing. The startup-movie skip checks a signature and fails soft (shared/startupMovieSkip.ts). Networking uses the exe hash only as a key that peers must share. So a non-matching YR gamemd.exe will likely still boot through the normal menus and lose only conveniences. The real unknowns are whether the generic Win32/DirectDraw shim, including the WM_BEEF launcher handshake in yr/profile.ts, accepts the user's binary, and whether that binary is DRM-wrapped.

'每个候选的 HD 层都得新写…各候选之间的区别只在于新渲染层怎样拿到游戏状态' contradicts the dossier. In the CD lineage and in vera20k, the host already decodes every SHP/VXL/TMP/PAL and renders every object and tile, so anything not yet replaced falls back for free and a scene graph and depth already exist. RA2 VM has no asset parsers at all (verified), and its renderer lives inside the exe. The dossier's own evaluation says HD there 'amounts to writing a new renderer driven by emulated game state'. The difference is the entire fallback renderer, not just how state is fetched.
YRpp is called 开源. The dossier says YRpp has no license file (gh API license=null). Only facts and addresses may be used. Do not copy its headers or struct code.

Phase 1 lists '盟军/苏军/尤里战役'. Yuri's Revenge has only Allied and Soviet campaigns. Yuri is playable only in skirmish and multiplayer, so there is no Yuri campaign to test. Separately, the original RA2 Allied/Soviet campaigns run on game.exe, which is pinned to what the dossier says is probably an XWIS multiplayer-client build, so they may not be testable with a retail exe at all.
Vanguard is described as '只有苏军 11 种单位'. The dossier says 11 types in total: 7 buildings (NACNST, NAPOWR, NAREFN, NAWEAP, NAHAND, NARADR, NALASR) and 4 units (SMCV, HARV, HTNK, E2).

Three claims are over-labeled. (a) 'OpenAI 条款禁止程序化提取输出【已验证】': the dossier rates this 'likely', because the policy page returned 403 and the text came from snippets. (b) The DLSS 5 '油腻/糊' community verdict: the dossier sources it only to an AI-written smzdm comment summary (LIKELY). (c) '光从左上来，影子投向右' is stated as a rule: the dossier labels it INFERENCE from looking at screenshots. Tag all three 较可能/推断.
'Visual Target image【已验证：Remastered 团队 AMAA】': the dossier sources the Visual Target image to the Apr 2019 EA Reddit update (r/commandandconquer bea82f), not to the 2020 AMAA.
'CD 从 2018 年运营至今': 2018 is the domain and copyright date. The dossier's patch notes begin at v0.1 on 2020-10-31.

'three.js r186 已经以 TSL 节点形式提供 … ClusteredLighting【已验证：r186 display nodes】': ClusteredLighting is in examples/jsm/lighting, not tsl/display. It 'must be used with WebGPURenderer' and needs compute, so it is not available on the WebGL2 fallback that the plan's Medium tier depends on.

The headline '只有它同时满足…原版功能完整' and '第一步基本不用做就有' overstate the evidence. The dossier verified these features only in code. No real-game test was ever run: all 918 passing tests are asset-free. Campaigns and long or 8-player matches are explicitly unvalidated, and v86 FPS has never been measured.
missing: DRM/launcher check for the purchased exe. The Steam (2229850) or EA App gamemd.exe may carry a store wrapper (e.g., a SteamStub .bind section or an EA .ooa section) or need EA-app activation that v86 cannot run. Stripping such a wrapper would be circumvention, which EA's modding guidelines forbid (dossier: 'must not circumvent content protection'). Whether the Steam build is wrapped is UNVERIFIED. Phase 0 day 1 needs a PE-section inspection and an explicit legal stop rule: if it is wrapped, do not strip it; go to vera20k, which needs no exe to play, or to an unwrapped CD/First Decade exe the user owns.

A v86 performance gate. No FPS number exists anywhere in the dossier. The plan measures FPS in Phase 0 but sets no pass/fail threshold before investing in HD. Suggested: a late-game YR skirmish at the chosen guest resolution must hold the selected game speed with stable logic fps. Otherwise pivot before Phase 2.

The compositing problem behind 渐进替换. 'Unreplaced objects from the upscaled original frame, replaced objects redrawn by the host' only works while terrain also comes from the guest frame. Once terrain, water (which must sit under units) or rain occlusion is host-rendered, unreplaced objects cannot be lifted out of a flattened RGB565 frame. You then need either (a) guest object draws redirected to a separate alpha surface, or (b) host-side re-rendering of the original SHP/VXL from draw records. Option (b) needs MIX/SHP/VXL/TMP decoders, palette and house remap, and a voxel rasterizer in the browser, i.e. L3. The Phase 3 slice (PBR terrain, water under units, rain occluded by buildings) implicitly needs this, yet L3 is marked 可选 with no estimate.

Determinism risk of skipping guest draws. RA2/YR draw paths are not guaranteed free of side effects on sync state (anim counters, the shared RNG). The plan's hook both records and skips. Do record-only plus host overdraw first, which does not change guest control flow, and make 'skip' a separate step with its own MP desync test.

Voxel replacement needs more than draw-call arguments. Turret facing, barrel state, slope tilt, HVA frame, and so on must be read from TechnoClass/UnitClass memory, which is extra per-field reverse engineering. This is not costed.

Aspect ratio and sidebar. Guest 1024×768 (4:3) against a 3456×2234 panel (~1.55:1) means letterboxing or distortion. Pick a guest resolution with the panel's aspect (e.g., 1152×745 for ×3, 1728×1117 for ×2). The shim accepts up to 2560×1600. Account for the fixed-pixel sidebar taking a larger share at low guest resolutions.

Host-side decoder reuse. The plan picks cnc-formats (Rust, 0.1.0-alpha) for offline extraction but says nothing about in-browser decoding, which the fallback and L3 need. Vanguard's @vanguard/formats is pure TS, GPL-3.0-or-later (compatible with RA2 VM), ported from XCC, 1,954 tests, and runs in a browser worker. Its CPU VXL rasterizer is also reusable.

The project's own reverse engineering is legal exposure the plan does not name. L1/L2 require this project to disassemble and hook gamemd.exe: draw functions and struct reads. The legal section attributes reverse engineering only to upstream. The EA User Agreement bans reverse engineering unless expressly authorized by EA or permitted by law, and interoperability exceptions (e.g., the EU Software Directive Art. 6) may not cover graphics replacement. The user's jurisdiction, probably China, is unknown.

Fork hygiene items from the dossier's adversarial legal review are missing from the cleanup list: the UI CSS modelled on Chrono Divide's style.css (src/ui/pages/game/styles.css comments), the CI real-game jobs that download game packages from secret URLs (GAME_RA2_URL/GAME_RA2_YR_URL in .github/workflows/quality-check.yml), and scripts/assets/extractIcon.mts, which extracts EA icons from game.exe.

The real cost of the vera20k fallback. Switching from TS/three.js to Rust/wgpu throws away all Phase 2 compositor and shader code; only assets carry over, and only if the asset contract is base-agnostic. vera20k also fails Step 1 (placeholder AI, no campaign, no network transport, no Nuke/Chronosphere/Dominator launch). So 'fallback to vera20k' really means HD-first with original gameplay later. The plan should say so.
Timeboxes and kill criteria in calendar time for (a) the G1-mismatch recovery path and (b) the Spike. The plan has gates but no 'stop after N weeks' rule.

Who does the 3D art. Claude Code can script bpy, but it cannot judge or hand-fix AI meshes: retopology, pivots, house-colour masks. It also cannot reliably rig and retarget infantry to exact RA2 frame counts. The plan needs a named owner or budget for this, e.g., outsourcing, a hired 3D artist, or reduced scope.

How to run real-game tests locally. The repo's tests/real-game suites exist but depend on private CI URLs. Phase 0 should adapt the harness to read the user's local gameres/ so regressions are automated rather than manual play.

Getting Windows-only Steam files onto a Mac is a blocker to G1 and is only listed as a decision. Add a concrete first attempt: steamcmd with a forced Windows platform, noted as unverified in the dossier. Fall back to CrossOver or a Windows machine.
overpromises_or_risks: '原版在浏览器里可玩 2–4 周' and '第一步基本不用做就有' rest on three unknowns: whether the user's exe runs (at minimum a DRM or launcher-handshake question), v86 performance, and zero real-game test runs. The two projects pin different YR '1.001' hashes (7b8a0685… and 1cdd1180…), and RA2's game.exe is likely an XWIS build. So a mismatch is the likely case, not the edge case, especially for original-RA2 (non-YR) content.

Phase 2 is estimated at 3–5 weeks but contains L1 plus L2 for two objects, visual targets, and a Chrome/Safari/WebGL2 matrix. Its G2 acceptance bar is near-production L2: 100+ units, correct occlusion, remap and shadows, 60 fps, and a 20-minute mixed HD/Classic MP match with no desync. The plan's own layer table says L2 = 几个月. The work means hand-written x86 trampolines debugged inside a WASM JIT emulator with no debugger. A realistic spike is 6–10 weeks, or split the gate.

Phase 3 at 2–4 months is optimistic. It needs de facto L3 for the slice map (see compositing), 3D rebuilds of 5 buildings with buildup, damage and active-anim frames aligned to the original, 2 rigged infantry sheets (~315 frames × 8 facings at 4×), glTF vehicles with turret/HVA state, PBR terrain with cliffs, JFA/Gerstner water, rain occluded by buildings, and a full VFX kit. Art throughput with a supervising non-artist is the bottleneck. Expect 4–8 months at this scope.

User-experience risk. The first real HD visuals arrive around month 4–6. Before that the user sees only L0 filters, which the dossier's own target-look research says the community calls 'oily/blurred'. For a user who wants to supervise every step, that is a long stretch with nothing convincing to review.

The 'Classic/HD live toggle = 要' recommendation forces frame-for-frame alignment on every HD asset, and on top of that the draw hook is keyed by frame number. This multiplies per-asset cost (infantry especially) and should be costed before the user is asked to decide.
HDR/XDR output, automatic tier selection from timestamp queries, and Safari/Firefox parity are scope that does not reduce the key risks. Put them after the slice.

Relying on YRpp addresses assumes the user's gamemd.exe has the same layout as YRpp's 1.001 build. A no-CD-style byte patch keeps the layout. A packed or wrapped exe does not until it is unpacked, and unpacking may be circumvention.

The 60 fps at 3456×2234 G-buffer budget is plausible on paper. But v86 JIT holds a CPU core, the Worker→main transfers of frames plus draw records are unmeasured, and the plan's COOP/COEP/SharedArrayBuffer assumption is not how RA2 VM works today: it uses postMessage transferables and no SAB (verified).
Uploading EA screenshots to ChatGPT Images for the visual targets may run into content filters on branded designs. Keep a local img2img fallback ready (FLUX.2 klein 4B, Apache-2.0).
The 12 up-front decisions overload the user before any evidence exists. Most of them (D4–D10) cannot be answered sensibly until G1, G2 and the visual targets exist.
efficiency_improvements: Make G1 a one-day probe as soon as the files arrive: hash the exe, inspect PE sections for DRM or wrappers, then boot the user's gamemd.exe with the hash-gated conveniences made fail-soft (the code shows they are optional). Result: hours to a G1 answer instead of '至少几周' of assumed re-derivation.

Collapse Phase 1 into a thin smoke test: a YR skirmish, save/load, one YR campaign mission with a briefing FMV, one 2-browser relay match, and a performance run. Run the full checklist in the background alongside Phase 2. Phase 1 as a gate does not reduce the critical-path risk, which is G2, and it delays the spike by 1–2 weeks.

Split G2. G2a takes 1–2 weeks: a record-only hook on one SHP draw and one voxel draw into a guest ring buffer, measuring draw-record rate and emulator overhead, plus host overdraw of one HD sprite with no skipping and no guest control-flow change. G2b adds skip, occlusion, remap, shadows and the MP desync test. Stop early if G2a's overhead or complexity is prohibitive.

In G2a, first enumerate guest surfaces with the existing inspectSurfaceObjects(). INFERENCE: YRpp documents separate DSurface instances (e.g., Tile, Composite, Sidebar). If terrain-only and sidebar surfaces are readable, you get a sidebar mask and a terrain/object separation with no draw hooks at all. That is a cheap L1 win and also fixes L0's '侧栏也会被处理' problem.

Start the host HD renderer now, in parallel and without game files: a three r186 WebGPU iso diorama (heightfield terrain, JFA shore foam and Gerstner water, compute rain, one explosion prefab) using placeholder or procedural art behind a base-agnostic RenderState/draw-list contract. It is needed whether RA2 VM ends at L2 or L3. It gives the user something visual to review in weeks 1–3, and it separates art direction from bridge risk.

For the vertical slice, render one small map fully host-side (terrain from map cells, all objects from draw records or object lists, original assets via in-browser decoders for anything not yet replaced) instead of compositing over the flattened guest frame. That is simpler than mixed compositing and it is where the slice has to end up anyway.

Reuse Vanguard's @vanguard/formats (TS, GPL-3.0-or-later, 1,954 tests) and its CPU VXL rasterizer for in-browser decoding. Use cnc-formats only as an offline cross-check. This avoids writing parsers and avoids an alpha Rust dependency in a TS stack.

Cut Phase 3 scope to: 1 real-time glTF vehicle (Grizzly), 1 infantry done as upscale plus ControlNet repaint of the original frames (no rig), 1–2 buildings, water, rain and one explosion type. Target a playable slice roughly 6–8 weeks after G2a, then widen.

Define a base-agnostic HD asset contract in Phase 2: KTX2 texture arrays keyed by SHP name and frame, glTF keyed by VXL section with HVA pivots, and a remap/emissive mask convention. The expensive part, the art, then survives a switch to vera20k.
Defer HDR/XDR, auto tiering, Safari/Firefox parity and UI/cameo redraws until after slice sign-off.
Ask for only 3 decisions now (buy/copy the files, YR-first, private-only sharing) plus sending the CD letter. Defer D4–D10 to the phase where evidence exists.
Try steamcmd with a forced Windows platform on the Mac before requiring a Windows PC, VM or CrossOver to extract the Steam files.
must_change: Rewrite G1 to match the verified code. For YR, hash gates cover only optional start-page trampolines, the perf reader, network timing and the dev spawner probe. G1 becomes: (1) PE/DRM-wrapper check, (2) does the user's exe boot through the menus with the gates fail-soft, (3) launcher handshake. Remove '重新推导所有补丁地址（至少几周）' as the default consequence, and add a legal stop rule: never strip a DRM wrapper.
Add an explicit v86 performance gate with numeric pass/fail thresholds in Phase 0, before any HD investment.

Acknowledge and cost the compositing/L3 problem. Progressive replacement over a flattened guest frame stops working as soon as terrain or water is host-rendered. The vertical slice needs host-side rendering of the whole slice, which means in-browser decoders plus a fallback renderer. Either put this in the spike scope with an estimate, or cut the slice.

Re-estimate: Phase 2 at 6–10 weeks or split into G2a/G2b with timeboxes; Phase 3 at 4–8 months at current scope, or cut the scope. Name the owner and budget for 3D cleanup and rigging, since Claude Code cannot do that work alone.
Replace '游戏逻辑一行不改' and '原版功能完整/第一步基本不用做就有' with accurate, conditional wording: runtime-patched, verified only in code, never run with real assets, campaigns and long/8-player MP unvalidated.

Fix the factual errors: YR has no Yuri campaign; Vanguard has 11 types, not 11 units; YRpp is unlicensed (facts only). Relabel the OpenAI ToS, DLSS 5 reaction and light-direction claims as 较可能/推断, and fix the Visual Target citation to bea82f.

Legal section: state that this project itself will reverse-engineer and hook gamemd.exe, which carries its own User Agreement and jurisdiction exposure. Add the missing fork-hygiene items: remove the CD-imitating CSS, disable CI jobs that pull game packages from secret URLs, and remove extractIcon outputs.

Present the vera20k fallback honestly: it discards the TS compositor work and also fails Step 1 (no campaign, AI, MP or key superweapons). Require the base-agnostic asset contract so the art survives a switch.
Choose the guest resolution to match the panel's aspect ratio (not 1024×768 4:3) and state how the sidebar is handled.
